description: The main window. It may call the host's own commands and nothing else: no shell, no filesystem and no network capability is granted to the UI, because every privileged path goes through freecode-tools' sandbox on the Rust side. The single exception is opening a web address, which the refusal links and the links inside an answer need — and it is scoped to `http` and `https` so a `file://` path or a `javascript:` address in model-written text cannot launch anything, whatever the user clicks.
